description: This file defines a Java interface for accessing Attachment data in a database, extending Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository, and includes methods for retrieving attachments by id, owner, and email.

classes.name: AttachmentRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Attachment persistence, providing query methods for attachment entities.

methods.name: findByIdAndOwner
methods.description: Finds an attachment by its ID and owner user.

methods.name: findByOwnerAndEmailOrderByCreatedAtAsc
methods.description: Finds all attachments owned by a specific user related to a specific email, ordered by creation date ascending.
